properties.description:
* WHAT...1 to 2 of inundation above ground level in low-lying

* WHERE...Sussex County Delaware.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM EST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated.

properties.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Warning means that moderate or major tidal
flooding is occurring or imminent. Be prepared for rising water
levels and take appropriate action to protect life and property.
Follow the recommendations of local emergency management
officials.

Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The water may be
deeper than you think it is. You will be putting yourself in
danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to costly
repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 27 at 8:56AM EST until November 27 at 6:00PM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by rain and backwater effects is expected
along the Manasquan and Metedeconk Rivers.

* WHERE...South Central Monmouth County in central New Jersey...
Northeastern Ocean County in southern New Jersey...

* WHEN...Until 600 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of low-lying areas near the Manasquan and
Metedeconk rivers is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 851 AM EST, gauge reports indicated both the Manasquan and
Metedeconk Rivers continued to rise after heavy rain yesterday
and further exacerbated by continued backwater effects from the
tidal flooding today. Flooding is already occurring in the warned
area.

expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Lakewood, Howell, Ramtown, Allenwood, Point Pleasant and Brielle.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

marinas along the river and in the Hontoon Island area.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

at 8:30 AM EST Friday was 6.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise through Major Flood
Stage, reaching 6.5 feet late this weekend, then 6.6 feet early
next week. The river is then forecast to remain steady through
mid next week.

properties.instruction:

expected. Minor tidal flooding often results in some road
closures. Usually, the most vulnerable roadways will flood.

Do not leave your vehicle at a location that is prone to tidal
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The
water may be deeper than you think it is. You will be putting
yourself in danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to
costly repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

properties.instruction:
Rip currents are powerful channels of water flowing quickly away
from shore, which occur most often at low spots or breaks in the
sandbar and in the vicinity of structures such as jetties and
piers. Heed the advice of lifeguards, beach patrol flags and
signs.

current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
